# SAM Battery test, Belgium vs the Netherlands. One console command: event wif_debug.23
#   Clears both armies and navies (air wings cannot be removed by script - disband them by
#   hand), gives both the 1950 air techs and three test designs, then:
#   BEL: SAM Battery + Radar-Guided SAM techs, a level 3 battery in Flanders (state 6, Brussels),
#        300 of each missile.
#   HOL: 100 armoured jet bombers, 200 jet fighters, 100 jet CAS in stock; Wasserfall,
#        atomic bomb and nuclear warhead projects done, 3 rocket sites in Holland (state 7),
#        10 nuclear missiles and 10 bombs. War if not at war. Runs fire control once.
#   The AI switch is console-only: type "ai" yourself.
#   wif_debug.24  Readout (any time; fire control runs weekly).

	id = wif_debug.23
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes

	immediate = {
		every_country = {
			limit = { OR = { tag = BEL tag = HOL } }
			delete_unit = { disband = no }

			destroy_ships = { type = heavy_cruiser count = all }
			destroy_ships = { type = light_cruiser count = all }
			destroy_ships = { type = destroyer count = all }
			destroy_ships = { type = submarine count = all }

			create_equipment_variant = {
				name = "WiF Test Jet"
				type = small_plane_airframe_5

					fixed_main_weapon_slot = aircraft_cannon_3_2x

				}
			}
			create_equipment_variant = {
				name = "WiF Test CAS"
				type = small_plane_airframe_5
				modules = {
					fixed_main_weapon_slot = bomb_locks_1
					fixed_auxiliary_weapon_slot_1 = aircraft_cannon_3_2x
					engine_type_slot = jet_engine_2x
				}
			}
			create_equipment_variant = {
				name = "WiF Test Bomber"
				type = large_plane_airframe_4
				modules = {
					fixed_main_weapon_slot = large_bomb_bay
					engine_type_slot = jet_engine_4x
					special_type_slot_1 = armor_plate_large
					special_type_slot_2 = armor_plate_large # two plates: defence 78, the ~3-SAM target
				}
			}
		}
		BEL = {
			set_technology = { wif_sam_battery_tech = 1 wif_rd_sam_tech = 1 popup = no }
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = wif_hs_sam_equipment_1 amount = 300 }
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = wif_rd_sam_equipment_1 amount = 300 }
			6 = {
				if = {
					limit = { wif_sam_battery < 3 }
					add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 3
					add_building_construction = { type = wif_sam_battery level = 3 instant_build = yes }
				}
			}
		}
		HOL = {
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = large_plane_airframe_4 amount = 100 variant_name = "WiF Test Bomber" }
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = small_plane_airframe_5 amount = 200 variant_name = "WiF Test Jet" }
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = small_plane_airframe_5 amount = 100 variant_name = "WiF Test CAS" }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { is_special_project_completed = sp:sp_nuclear_bomb } } complete_special_project = sp:sp_nuclear_bomb }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { is_special_project_completed = sp:sp_rockets_ballistic_missile } } complete_special_project = sp:sp_rockets_ballistic_missile }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { is_special_project_completed = sp:sp_nuclear_warheads } } complete_special_project = sp:sp_nuclear_warheads }
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = nuclear_missile_equipment_1 amount = 10 }
			add_nuclear_bombs = 10
			7 = {
				if = {
					limit = { rocket_site < 3 }
					add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 3
					add_building_construction = { type = rocket_site level = 3 instant_build = yes }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { BEL = { NOT = { has_war_with = HOL } } }
			BEL = { declare_war_on = { target = HOL type = annex_everything } }
		}
		BEL = { wif_sam_weekly = yes }
	}
}
